title: Cartman Residence

First: TheCartman Residenceis whereEric CartmanandLiane Cartmanlive inSouth Park. It makes its first appearance in theSeason Oneepisode, "Cartman Gets an Anal Probe" and serves as amajor locationthroughout theseries.

The residence was vacated in "City People", with Cartman family moving into a smallerConey Island Hotdog. It had been occupied by thePrinceandPrincessof Canada in "The Worldwide Privacy Tour", until it got occupied by Liane and Cartman again in "DikinBaus Hot Dogs".

Cartman's house is built similarly to the other houses in South Park, painted in different colors. In its earlier appearances it was originally shown as a brown color but it became green (similar to theMarsh Residence, theBroflovski Residence, theMcCormick Residence, and theTestaburger Residence) in later episodes.

South Park: The Fractured But Whole[]: The New Kid heads here at the start of the game to get the Wizard's help with the Battle of Kupa Keep. The C*** then comes to tell the boys he's from the future and tells them to get back into C*** and Friends, but rejects the New Kid because they are a "dork".
The New Kid heads to the C*** lair (in the basement) to convince the Coon to let them play, and the C*** gives them a backstory, before instructing them to get followers on C***stagram.
After recruitingHuman KiteandSuper Craig, the C*** brings them back to teach them about Artifacts.

The C*** calls them back again afterThe Burrito Whispereris complete to update their backstory, giving them a second class. After this is done, Human Kite calls the C*** to tell him theFreedom Palsare causing trouble on Main Street, and the two head there.

Once the Freedom Pals are defeated, the C*** and Friends return to the base to examineDoctor Timothy's phone and find out about the "stripper with a dick tattoo". The Coon tells the New Kid to go home and await their night mission withanother C*** and Friends member.
After the New Kid and Captain Diabetes manage to catchClassi, the C*** and Friends interrogate her about Scrambles, only to be interrupted by Liane, who demands all the boys go home to bed.

Near the end of Day 2, the C*** and Friends discuss what they have found before the group gets a call from another Freedom Pal, asking to meet them. The rest of the group leaves, with the C*** and the New Kid staying behind. The New Kid "convinces" the C*** to give them another class, and a new backstory is given, this time with a Visitor. The two then head to the park forCivil War 2: Playtime's Over.

After the fight, the group discusses Classi's information about theU-STOR-ITand decides to go there on the night.Mosquitoinforms them that the entrance is blocked by lava, and, since he owes the New Kid a favor, the group decides to getToolshedto help them.

After completingThe Hundred Hands of Chaos, the group interrogatesProfessor Chaos, who tells them about his boss, with the C*** theorizing that the boss is actually Mitch Conner. Human Kite labels the theory as stupid and the group head back to bed.
The next day, the group decides they must infiltrate the Freedom Pals to get a lead on Scrambles. Chaos volunteers to help the New Kid, and the two head out to work.

After the New Kid gets information from the Freedom Pals, the C*** and Friends plan to infiltrate thePolice Stationon the night. The group leaves, and the New Kid once again convinces the C*** to give them another class.

DuringFarts of Future Past, the New Kid heads back to the start of the game and, after defeating their past self, confronts the C*** and Mitch Conner, who take the New Kid through time to their origin story.
When the New Kid speaks to Liane, she gives them a quest to give out business cards. After this is done, she gives them some brownies, essential for unlocking the Timefart Summon.
Liane calls the New Kid back later to help stop the pimp who has come by following the growth of Liane's business. The New Kid fights the pimp by simply giving him pimp slaps.
AFastpassflag can be found outside the house.

## South Park: The Fractured But Whole[]
The New Kid heads here at the start of the game to get the Wizard's help with the Battle of Kupa Keep. The C*** then comes to tell the boys he's from the future and tells them to get back into C*** and Friends, but rejects the New Kid because they are a "dork".

The New Kid heads to the C*** lair (in the basement) to convince the Coon to let them play, and the C*** gives them a backstory, before instructing them to get followers on C***stagram.

After recruitingHuman KiteandSuper Craig, the C*** brings them back to teach them about Artifacts.

The C*** calls them back again afterThe Burrito Whispereris complete to update their backstory, giving them a second class. After this is done, Human Kite calls the C*** to tell him theFreedom Palsare causing trouble on Main Street, and the two head there.

Once the Freedom Pals are defeated, the C*** and Friends return to the base to examineDoctor Timothy's phone and find out about the "stripper with a dick tattoo". The Coon tells the New Kid to go home and await their night mission withanother C*** and Friends member.

After the New Kid and Captain Diabetes manage to catchClassi, the C*** and Friends interrogate her about Scrambles, only to be interrupted by Liane, who demands all the boys go home to bed.

Near the end of Day 2, the C*** and Friends discuss what they have found before the group gets a call from another Freedom Pal, asking to meet them. The rest of the group leaves, with the C*** and the New Kid staying behind. The New Kid "convinces" the C*** to give them another class, and a new backstory is given, this time with a Visitor. The two then head to the park forCivil War 2: Playtime's Over.

After the fight, the group discusses Classi's information about theU-STOR-ITand decides to go there on the night.Mosquitoinforms them that the entrance is blocked by lava, and, since he owes the New Kid a favor, the group decides to getToolshedto help them.

After completingThe Hundred Hands of Chaos, the group interrogatesProfessor Chaos, who tells them about his boss, with the C*** theorizing that the boss is actually Mitch Conner. Human Kite labels the theory as stupid and the group head back to bed.

The next day, the group decides they must infiltrate the Freedom Pals to get a lead on Scrambles. Chaos volunteers to help the New Kid, and the two head out to work.

After the New Kid gets information from the Freedom Pals, the C*** and Friends plan to infiltrate thePolice Stationon the night. The group leaves, and the New Kid once again convinces the C*** to give them another class.

DuringFarts of Future Past, the New Kid heads back to the start of the game and, after defeating their past self, confronts the C*** and Mitch Conner, who take the New Kid through time to their origin story.

When the New Kid speaks to Liane, she gives them a quest to give out business cards. After this is done, she gives them some brownies, essential for unlocking the Timefart Summon.

Liane calls the New Kid back later to help stop the pimp who has come by following the growth of Liane's business. The New Kid fights the pimp by simply giving him pimp slaps.
